results.name: Copy-only batch validates all rows, forbids identities/unknowns, enforces 32 rows and UTF-8 budget
Portable note copies round-trip editable fields only; unknown envelopes and identities are refused
Merge creates a separate saved-body composition, preserves inputs and rejects oversized output
Heading splits ignore fenced headings and preserve the exact CRLF source when rejoined
Literal replace is exact/case-sensitive, supports deletion, and refuses explosive expansion before construction
Link construction replaces only the selected range, rejects active schemes/bracket labels, encodes URL parentheses
Pipe tables parse escaped pipes/backslashes and alignment, keep HTML as text and bound rows/columns
Templates expand only three plain tokens using the supplied real clock; no expression execution or recursive evaluation
Saved-body/clipboard line diff exactly reconstructs each side, including empty/CRLF/Unicode; it is not an LCS claim
Clipboard tools refuse sensitive/oversized/invalid text without discarding original entries
Template budget includes the complete wrapper: exact 4 MiB roundtrip, one byte over refused
Native LF textarea offsets map back to exact CRLF/CR source excerpts, with invalid ranges refused
Source/native textarea ranges invert across every boundary in mixed CRLF/CR/Unicode text
Create-only clipboard destinations reject Private, traversal, repeated slash and noncanonical paths
Same-millisecond/clock-rollback captures retain distinct identities and independent removal/pin targets
170,000 retained pins do not overflow a timestamp spread/argument stack
Resource filters validate exact UTC calendar days, half-open intervals and canonical safe byte ranges
Folder exclusion is canonical, rejects traversal and retains SQL wildcard characters as literal path data
Literal paging allows exactly four bounded public offsets, rejects ranked/metadata/invalid continuations
New resource predicates round-trip complete profiles/history, while legacy profiles get explicit empty defaults
Result JSON is lossless for visible rows/query; CSV neutralizes spreadsheet formulas and independently parses quotes/newlines
Comparison-limit copy attack: supplementary Unicode is counted as UTF-16 code units, never MiB bytes
